name: Previous day high breakout
description: Intraday price action: buy when price closes above yesterday's high on strong volume.

about.how_it_works: Yesterday's high and low are levels almost every trader watches. A close above yesterday's high, on at least one and a half times the usual volume, means buyers are pushing into new territory with conviction. The stop goes under the breakout candle, the target is twice the risk, and the trade gets one day to work.
about.fails_when: Quiet days, when price pokes above the level and falls back (a 'failed breakout'). The volume filter removes many of these.
